thread:
Jonah: quick pulse on the hot-slate warmup rollout — canary showed p95 jump ~120ms after 10m of traffic, any guesses?
Lia: saw that, looks correlated with `kv_warmup_concurrency` bump in the kernel branch. open to reverting.
Matt: filing context — the concurrency bump was to reduce cold-starts for 4k+ seqs, but may be causing contention on the prefetch queue. PR #4821.
Sara: FYI eng-infra reported higher CPU steal on the canary hosts around the same time. CC @Kevin.
Kevin: confirmed, we had an unrelated maintenance job that overlapped; I killed it since it was long running. should be clear now.
Jonah: thanks. Lia — can you paste the exact kernel flag you changed? want to see if it's inside the fast-path.
Lia: sure: ```--kv-warmup-concurrency=12
--prefetch-window=32
// kernel change: prioritize-requested-prefetch=true```
Jonah: ok. if we revert concurrency to 8 do we expect cold-starts to spike?
Matt: yes some spike but p50 latency is fine; p95 we're seeing comes from queue-head churn under higher concurrency. revert to 8 should remove the spike.
Sara: I'll monitor canary after revert. infra-bot: deploy rollback started for canary cluster (deploy-2026-06-22-19:02).
infra-bot: canary health: starting checks (cpu, mem, net, rpc).
Lia: also noticed the KV cache eviction heuristic change landed in the ramp — `evict_age_ms` lowered to 3000 which reduces effective cache hit for repeated prefixes. I'm going to revert that too.
Jonah: is that in a separate PR?
Lia: yes PR #4830, small change in cache policy.
Kevin: if we revert both changes we should coordinate with eng-sre so they don't see noise in service-level alerts. tagging them in the rollback ticket.
Matt: I'm going to mark ownership: kernel concurrency tweak -> Kernel team (Matt, Lia). KV eviction tweak -> Cache team (Lia). Infra overlap -> Kevin. Monitoring/alerts -> Sara.
Jonah: dependencies note — Cache team needs the KV metrics export fix from eng-metrics (ticket MET-214) to validate hit-rate; we don't have that yet. Lia, can you add a guard in your test harness to simulate metrics until MET-214 lands?
Lia: adding a simple exporter in the e2e harness now. should be up by EOD.
Sara: will run a 30m canary after the rollback and report p50/p95 and hit-rate.
Matt: quick code-review ping: please review PR #4821 (kernel concurrency) and #4830 (cache policy). both marked `needs-review`.
Jonah: timeline — aim to finish revert + canary check in the next 90 minutes. if good, schedule a staged rollout to dedicated pools tomorrow morning.
Kevin: noted, I'll reserve the windows and disable the maintenance job for next 6 hours.
infra-bot: canary rollback completed (deploy-2026-06-22-19:10). health checks: cpu ok, mem ok, rpc latencies nominal.
Sara: initial numbers after rollback (10m window): p50 -3ms, p95 -110ms (back to baseline), cache hit-rate +4%. will run full 30m and post final.
Jonah: perfect. follow-ups: Lia to open follow-up PR to add a dynamic flag for `kv_warmup_concurrency` (so we can tune via config), Matt to add a note in the kernel changelog about queue contention, Kevin to annotate the maintenance scheduler to prevent overlap, Sara to close the canary ticket with measurements.
Lia: will do PR and add test harness exporter.
Matt: I'll add changelog entry and add a small perf test to reproduce head-of-queue churn.
Kevin: scheduler change done, noted recurrence window.
Sara: posting final canary metrics in 20m.
Jonah: thanks all — if anyone hits a regression ping this thread. :thumbsup:
